defects_and_remediations.title: Groq 400 Invalid Request caused by CrewAI cache_breakpoint metadata
defects_and_remediations.root_cause: CrewAI v1.15.27 injects cache_breakpoint into message dictionaries. Groq API strictly enforces its OpenAPI spec and rejects unknown message properties with HTTP 400.
defects_and_remediations.remediation: Narrow integration inside LiteLLM's GroqChatConfig transformation layer that automatically strips cache_breakpoint for Groq endpoints without mutating caller shared dictionaries or altering global litellm functions.

defects_and_remediations.title: Missing root endpoint GET / returning 404 Not Found
defects_and_remediations.root_cause: FastAPI app lacked a root route handler.
defects_and_remediations.remediation: Added GET / route returning app name, version, status, and navigation catalog.
